nodes.label: Suite: attendance-report EDITING (permission matrix, local-date formatting, id threading)
Role matrix: worker edits own row only; עידן(admin)/עמיחי(CEO) edit ANYONE; viewer edits NOTHING even own row; plain team member (e.g. מתניה) cannot edit others
attYmd must format via LOCAL date parts, never toISOString (avoids midnight day-shift in Israel TZ)
✏️ edit button requires canEd AND (attendance row id OR editable visit); field-day rows carry visitId never a bare attendance id
Suite: attMissingDays golden fixtures, holiday-aware reminders, accumulating bell
attMissingDays golden: weekdays only, holidays/company-closures excluded unless required:true, defaults to SHEET_DATA.holidays (spec §7e)
Role matrix: red missing-attendance row shows 🔔 nag button for viewer role, NO button for team role (informative text only)
Suite: attendance person-toggle people list (union + dedup + filter + he-sort)
Suite: phone Back-button rule (backAction) + history contracts + legacy/React copy parity
backAction(state) has exactly 4 answers: ask-unsaved (dirty dialog) > close-dialog (untouched dialog) > prev-page (nothing open, history left) > confirm-exit (sentinel/unknown state)
§7p unsaved-changes copy (UNSAVED_BODY/SAVE/DISCARD/KEEP) must be byte-identical between js/src/00-guard.js (legacy) and app/src/lib/useUnsavedGuard.tsx (React)
Suite: end-to-end delivery-certificate PDF pipeline (certDocHtml -> headless Edge print-to-PDF -> markitdown text assertions)
Numbered cert PDF contains the cert number; draft cert PDF omits it and contains טיוטה — neither contains a currency symbol
Suite: 📝 יומן היום day-log — prompt drift guard, EMS gate, headless save, bridge surface, comment wording parity
supabase/functions/parse-daylog/prompt.md and the inlined PROMPT template literal in index.ts must be textually identical, and every {{PLACEHOLDER}} the builder fills must exist in the prompt
daylog_corrections stores only raw_len + before/after JSON, never the raw day-log text; RLS insert is authenticated-only
Audit C #13: a `source` name invented by the day-log parser is IGNORED for stock movement — the company pool (חברה) is the only source, there are no personal bags
Suite: delivery-certificate module — certDocHtml, prefill, issue/reissue/cancel, viewer-mode action gating, cert_by_id RPC route, certSendPlan
Role matrix (invRenderCerts action cell): viewer sees ONLY 👁 הצג (+📁 if drive_url); non-viewer sees full set 📤/📝 הפק מתוקנת/🚫 בטל; cancelled rows never show reissue/cancel to anyone

Public ?cert=<uuid> view route reads through the SECURITY DEFINER cert_by_id(uuid) RPC (not the raw table anon SELECT, which made every certificate enumerable); falls back to the legacy table read only if the RPC 404s (pre-migration deploy window)
certReissue opens the STORED row's own customer block (not kibbutz_details lookup); issuing the reissued cert auto-cancels the replaced cert via a deliveryCertCancel POST carrying replacedBy
certSendPlan (legacy mirror) must match the vitest golden of app/src/lib/certSend.ts certSendPlan: only active+emailable contact ticked, needsContact when nobody is emailable
Suite: per-ticket status board — devStage bucketing (·97 fix), devBoardLayout, devTree, devFlowSegments, write paths, tokens
·97 invariant: every ticket sits in the column matching ITS OWN status — a child whose status differs from its parent lands in its own column, never bucketed under the parent's

Task 11 (spec §7d): live GitHub Projects board rework (2026-09-08) — devStage maps Main Fields/Backlog/Scope Refinement/Sprint Ready/In Progress/In Review/Committed (Done option removed, folds into Committed); devBoardLayout = 4 full columns (ready/prog/review/backlog) + collapsible rail (fields/scope/committed)
Suite: edge-function import surface — no duplicate/colliding import bindings across supabase/functions/*/index.ts

Task 34 incident: push-send index.ts imported `digestBody` from both usageNarrative.ts and alerts.ts, a module-level SyntaxError that boots the function down for every cron call; this offline gate checks every supabase/functions/*/index.ts for (1) duplicate imported binding names (2) import-vs-toplevel-decl collisions (3) the same module imported twice
Suite: EMS-cache slim mapper (emsSlimTask description field) + stale-cache resync (EMS_CACHE_VER guard)

emsResyncIfStaleCache: a cache with no `ver` or an older ver, while EMS-connected, resyncs exactly once and stamps the current EMS_CACHE_VER; disconnected or already-current or no-tasks caches never resync; a per-session guard flag prevents a resync loop
Suite: EMS createTask id extraction (emsCreatedId) + emsWriteOrQueue + queue flush resolving pending:<id>
emsCreatedId must read the id from BOTH EMS response shapes — flat {id} and wrapped {data:{id}} — coerced to string; a list response ({data:[...]}) is never mistaken for a created resource
Suite: EMS_STATUS_LABEL/EMS_PRIORITY_LABEL (TS mirror) byte-identical to EMS_STATUS/EMS_PRIORITY (legacy backend enum)
Suite: office-PC EMS cache refresh job (scripts/ems-cache-refresh.mjs) — mapper parity, crawl/pagination, background-sync throttle, credential hygiene, main() exit codes
scripts/ems-cache-refresh.mjs slimTask() must produce the SAME slim row (same keys, same order) as js/src/13-ems.js emsSlimTask() over every fixture row — a drift would blank task text on every card
emsBgDue throttle: never-synced is due; inside the 5-min window is not due; past it is due; a clock jump backwards is treated as due (never parked for hours)

No hardcoded secret in scripts/ems-cache-refresh.mjs; reads EMS_PASSWORD/EMS_TOKEN via pick(); .env is git-ignored and not tracked; the log never contains a password/token value; exit code table {OK:0,UNEXPECTED:1,CONFIG:2,LOGIN:3,FETCH:4,WRITE:5} matches docs/ems-cache-refresh.md
Suite: field-visit push flow contract sweep — Edge Function parity, visitCron auth/idempotency, adoption guards ג, deep links, island mounting, migration/cron, copy rules

Adoption guards ג: PUSH_DAILY_CAP=3 global ceiling, VISIT_DAILY_CAP=2, GAP_DAILY_CAP=1; attendanceCron/attendanceReminder/usageDigest/inventoryDigest are cap-exempt; quiet hours 21:00→06:30; REMINDER_LATEST_HH=20 is a GATE not an accelerator (≥30min after arrival else no push); a day with no sendable moment settles as 'late', never retried
UI copy rules: no system talk (no Supabase/RLS/API mentions), nobody told who else (עמיחי/עידן) sees their data, nudges never threaten
Suite: inventory alerts contract sweep — Edge Function parity, inventoryAlert/inventoryDigest auth+idempotency, quiet-hours exception, trigger safety, SQL runbook, island wiring
§7k ג: the immediate low-stock push is the ONE documented quiet-hours EXCEPTION (never gated by inQuietHours); every other nudge still honours quiet hours; the digest is exempt from the daily cap

Task 8 review 'Important': inventory_alert_on_movement trigger body is wrapped in an exception handler — a push failure is `raise notice`, never `raise exception`, so it can never fail the movement insert itself
Suite: unified inventory pool (legacy half) — computeStock/poolStockMap/lowStockReport, visit-save supply path, order approval/delivery paths, migration, golden ledger for returns

poolStockMap nets only movement rows touching חברה (the one pool); migration rows (reason=pool_migration) make the pool the sum of the old per-person bags, which all land on 0; the red line (low-stock) is read off the POOL only, never a person

Audit C #12: returnToStock() must name BOTH ends (kibbutz → חברה, reason return_restock) — a fromLocation:'' credited the pool from nowhere; a second press against the same refId+reason must post nothing (idempotency), and a return with no kibbutz is refused rather than crediting from nowhere

INV_LOCATIONS=[חברה] and STOCK_HOLDERS=[] (spec §1) — no person holds a personal bag; per-person order distribution write is gone (column kept, unused); the visit-save supply movement always sources from חברה regardless of visitor
Suite: 🔥 צריבות pure logic — state/search/filter/group/sort/patches/Excel export/EMS refresh mapping/audience gating (Task 23)

Task 23: BURN_WRITERS (אביאם/ניתאי/עידן/עמיחי) and BURN_HIDDEN (מתניה/אליה) plus the BURNS_PROJECT_ACTIVE removal flag must be IDENTICAL between the legacy table (js/src/24-meter-burns.js, BURN-AUDIENCE-START/END markers) and app/src/lib/burns.ts — one audience shared by legacy table + 4 React surfaces (card chip, card-modal section, briefing rows, landing strip)
rowState: burned PP is plain 'burned'; burned CT is 'burned-ct' — a COLOUR distinction, never a separate status word (22.9 ruling)

emsToBurnRows converts raw EMS /meters+/solars payloads to meter_burns upsert rows (EMS columns only — never touches status/note/generator_id tracking columns); skips non-E360 and site-less meters; dedupes solar names
Suite: push action-buttons + scheduled attendance logic (kindForHour, priorMissing, orderActions) — ported mirror of supabase/functions/push-send/index.ts
orderActions: a pending SUPPLIER order offers one-tap ['approve','view']; a pending CUSTOMER order offers ['approveOpen','view'] (in-app only); anything not pending offers ['view'] only
Suite: Web Push recipient routing (computeRecipients) — ported mirror of js/src/22-push.js / js/src/07-orders.js

Recipient routing invariant: 'pending' push goes to exactly whoever can approve that order (supplier ≤10→אביאם, supplier >10→עמיחי, customer→אביאם+ניתאי); 'approved' push goes to APPROVE_GROUP minus the approver and minus the creator; never self-notify
Suite: ONE roster, ONE viewer spelling — every person list derived from/asserted against js/src/00-bridge.js APP_PEOPLE + VIEWER_NAME (audit A · A4/A5/A12)

Audit A4/A5/A12: STAFF_PEOPLE/MEETING_PEOPLE/app.src.lib.people.ts must all derive from APP_PEOPLE (never re-typed); EMS_USERS must be a subset; the viewer has exactly ONE canonical name 'צפייה' (what the login gate stores) and the dead spelling 'צופה' must never be branched on in production sources (js/src, app/src)
Suite: linkage audit row builder (emsSiteAuditRows) — kibbutz-to-EMS-site link status
Suite: kibbutz-modal EMS section blocks task creation when the kibbutz has no linked EMS site
Suite: applyCardSiteWarnings — ⚠️ chip appears only on site-less kibbutz cards
Suite: saveVisit delivery-cert GATE — equipment supply requires an issued cert, for new visits and edits that add products

Cert gate rule: a NEW visit with checked products and no issued cert is BLOCKED (mints a draft visit id the cert will link to); once a cert is issued for that draft id the save proceeds with the same id; editing a visit that ALREADY had products passes with no cert; editing a visit to ADD products where none existed before IS gated; a visit with no products is never gated
Suite: visit-draft autosave (spec §5.1c) — 800ms debounce, restore round-trip, multi-kibbutz slots, cross-device merge, v1→v2 migration

visitDraftTouch debounces to exactly ONE save 800ms after the LAST keystroke (not one write per keystroke); visitDraftFlush saves immediately and cancels the pending timer; an untouched form leaves no draft; editing an existing visit never writes a draft

Review fix 1: drafts are keyed per (person, kibbutz, day) — a draft started at a second kibbutz on the same day must not destroy the first device slot; a v1 single-slot draft in localStorage is migrated (not lost) into the v2 keyed store

Review fix 2: draftMergeRows resolves conflicts by NEWEST updated_at wins (remote or local); a remote draft for a kibbutz this device never saw is added; junk server rows are ignored; the merge never mutates the mirror handed to it
Suite: writeVisit created_at stamping — pre-minted visit ids (cert-gate flow) still stamp created_at on INSERT, edits preserve it

created_at guard: `if (!b.id || b.isNew) row.created_at = ...` — insert with a pre-minted id (isNew:true) stamps created_at; insert with no id at all generates one and stamps it; an edit (id present, no isNew) never touches created_at; an explicit createdAt is honored on insert

hyperedges.label: Three suites converge on the delivery-certificate feature: certDocHtml rendering (test-cert-pdf), the full module (test-delivery-cert), and the save-time gate that forces its existence (test-visit-cert-gate)
Four suites together guard the EMS cache/sync pipeline against drift: slim mapper (card), id extraction (createtask), label mirror (labels), and the scheduled office-PC job (refresh)
Three small suites guard the kibbutz<->EMS-site linkage end to end: the audit table (site-audit), the create-task block (site-block), and the card warning chip (site-indicator)

The §7k ג adoption guards (daily push cap, quiet hours, digest exemptions) are cross-checked from both the field-visit flow and the inventory-alerts flow so the two push producers never exceed the shared per-day budget
The unified inventory pool (spec §1/§2/§4, audit C #12/#13) is guarded jointly by the pool math/return-ledger suite and the day-log save-path suite that must never reintroduce a personal-bag source
